reports.title: AMERICAS GOLD AND SILVER CORPORATION Condensed Interim Consolidated Financial Statements For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025 (In thousands of U.S. dollars, unless otherwise stated, unaudited)

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Americas’ consolidated production guidance for 2026 is a range between 3.2 million and 3.6 million ounces of silver at an AISC range of $30 to $35 per ounce sold. The Company expects to achieve the low end of existing full-year production guidance and the high end of AISC guidance range.
